notes: ACCESS/RULE 3: ampm.fr no longer runs an independent storefront -- it 301-redirects (confirmed via curl -D and via probe.py's final_url) to https://www.laredoute.fr/pplp/cat-85201.aspx, i.e. AM.PM is now sold as a brand-filtered subtree of La Redoute's own French platform (same corporate group as S.N. 90 La Redoute UK and S.N. 106 La Redoute Interieurs FR in this batch). This is a genuinely live, substantial catalogue, just reached at a different domain -- extracted per Rule 3's 'redirects to a different live catalogue' case; all links below are laredoute.fr, not ampm.fr, by design. Direct fetch and a 10-profile curl_cffi sweep (chrome131/124/120/116/110, safari17_0/18_0_ios/15_5, edge101, firefox133) all returned Cloudflare 403 challenge on laredoute.fr, matching the c90.json (La Redoute UK) precedent exactly. WebFetch (renders past the interstitial) was used for every page and is the sole access route, also matching c90.json. Every AM.PM page confirmed brand-filtered via visible 'AM.PM' product labels and '<Category> AM.PM' page headings. VERIFICATION: used children-sum-to-parent as the primary exhaustion check -- Luminaire (Lighting) parent header '187' = 41+37+44+52+13 (its five filter children) exactly; Objet de decoration parent header '254' = 49+47+134+25 (its four kept children, Papier peint/wallpaper excluded) within 1, acceptable per Rule 1 session-drift allowance. Spot re-verified the two largest leaf counts (Cache-pot/vase 134, Suspension/plafonnier 41) with a second independent WebFetch call each -- both reproduced exactly, no drift. EXCLUDED: Papier peint (wallpaper, standing exclusion); Rangement deco 76 (baskets/boxes/coat-stands/trunks -- storage, excluded on the same reasoning as 'Storage Decor' on the sibling c90.json La Redoute UK extraction); Decoration exterieure 14 (mixed roll-up of outdoor rug, fire pit/brasero, a garden side table alongside some planters/lanterns -- majority non-qualifying types and overlaps Luminaire exterieur already counted separately, dropped per the mixed-roll-up rule); Tapis (rugs), Coussin/housse de coussin (cushions), Rideaux/voilage (curtains), Boutis/plaid/edredon (quilts/throws) -- all textiles; Couverts (cutlery), Linge de table (table linens); Meuble, Canape/fauteuil, Table/chaise, Lit/literie, Collection canapes, Collection mobilier de jardin (all furniture); Linge de maison, Collection linge de maison (textiles); Jardin top-nav is the same branch as the excluded Decoration exterieure child; Nouveautes (marketing/new-arrivals nav). No clock (horloge/pendule) category exists on this brand's nav. RULE 0 GAIN: kept Luminaire exterieur (outdoor lighting, 10) as its own leaf row -- a room/location-qualified lighting branch a room-word exclusion would have dropped; it sits outside the main Luminaire parent's summed total (187) at a different URL depth, so it is additive, not double-counted. RULE 0.6: 'Assiette, bol' (48, URL cat-197178) and 'Bol, tasse' (27, URL cat-245969) are two distinct sibling nav nodes under Art de la table with overlapping English meaning (both include bowls) -- could not verify product-ID overlap because the site blocks all fetch methods except WebFetch (no raw JSON/HTML access to compare IDs); kept both as the site's own genuine same-level nav nodes and flagged for merge-time review rather than dropped, per Rule 0.6's 'when in doubt, include and document.' FLAG: 'Abat-jour, accessoires electriques' (13) is a small mixed node -- approx 11 of 13 are decorative lampshades (in scope) and 2 are functional items (an electrical cable, an LED string light); kept as one row since the site offers no finer split, flagged in its row.
